title: logout applet: keyboard shortcut to interact with widget in widget settings non-functional
line: The Lock/Logout widget's keyboard shortcut now runs its action, or focuses its buttons when it shows more than one.
explanation: The Lock/Logout widget shows its buttons directly and never handled its own activation, so the global shortcut set in its settings fired but nothing listened to it. Panels also don't take keyboard focus unless their containment asks for input. Now the shortcut runs the action when only one button is shown; otherwise it puts the panel in input mode (as the Focus Panel shortcut does) and focuses the first button, so Tab/Enter pick one. The focused button also gets the same highlight as a hovered one.

commits.message:
applets/lock_logout: react to the widget's keyboard shortcut

The widget had no handler for its activation, so the shortcut set in its
settings did nothing. It now runs the action when only one button is shown,
and otherwise gives keyboard focus to the first button so it can be picked.

BUG: 500462

media.caption: Master: two seconds after pressing the widget's shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+9) nothing in the widget has focus
Fixed: after the shortcut the panel's focus marker sits on the Lock button
Master: Ctrl+Alt+9, then Enter; nothing happens
Fixed: Ctrl+Alt+9 focuses Lock, Enter locks the screen
